svg.aria-label: siddhant-pardeshi/BloodDonation-Management: 🩸 LifeDrop — full-stack Blood Donation Management System connecting donors, hospitals & blood camps. React + Vite frontend, Spring Boot + MySQL REST API with live inventory for all 8 blood groups, 90-day eligibility rules & animated landing page.
